# HQ Operating Brief

## Working mode and authority

- Use GPT-6 Luna for ordinary work and isolated task contexts. Use GPT-6.1 Sol only for complex architecture or critical safety/authority decisions.
- The original repository remains a private archive. The new public destination is not selected or created; publication, remote writes, and GitHub plan spend remain at zero.
- Local implementation and synthetic checks are permitted. The assembled copy is a new source identity; bind any evidence to its exact final-tree hash before claiming a result.
- The active .github/workflows directory contains no executable YAML. Preserve the legacy workflows outside Actions discovery until the Option 3 controller/runner boundary and host access controls are separately established.
- No release acceptance, Actions run, owner-data workload, operational PAPER, soak, deployment, or publication is claimed or authorized by this brief. Local source development is not blocked by those operational gates.

## Product and decisions to preserve

- Preserve all 26 Python distributions and the Web Console, including Core/backtesting, Market Data, strategy modules/plugins, research/audit, Paper/Runner, Control Plane, Acceptance/Recovery, Observability, and Risk Supervisor.
- Keep breakout_return, fvg_rt with explicit FVG-retest semantics, and liquidity_sweep under neutral shared contracts. Research remains STOP until separately approved; independent audit precedes any PAPER stage.
- Signal Bot is optional and notification-only; it is not an execution engine or state owner.
- #933 is the selected future single PAPER accounting owner in Core SQLite. Local implementation is permitted. Operational PAPER stays closed while canonical writer/identity, capital and risk limits, authoritative order/position/terminal/reconciliation/protection sources, and populated-state migration are missing.
- #396 uses one deterministic shared pool while preserving independent positions per strategy: fixed priority, then stable instanceID; reject the whole request on insufficient capital; hold durable reservations until authoritative terminal outcome or reconciled recovery.
- #395 requires a durable Lifecycle owner and Core SQLite generations with multi-instance identity and recovery. SUSPEND blocks new risk and quarantines ambiguous state; only verified position-level protective actions continue. RESUME requires explicit operator action plus fresh plan, data, and protection validation.
- Require Linux operational support and separate Darwin acceptance for the same exact final source identity. Python 3.12 and 3.13 remain intended support versions; acceptance is pending.
- MDI startup authentication is mandatory. Option 3 controller/publisher has no actual trading or owner-data authority.

## Evidence and boundaries

- Historical integration refs, checks, grants, issue/PR records, and receipts are archival only; they do not identify or accept the new assembled root. Exact final-root identity is pending.
- Keep PROJECT_STATE semantic content unchanged.
- #1190 CP-10 STOP remains active. #250 research remains stopped/planning-only until a successor contract and separate authorization; no robustness, HOLDOUT, or PAPER stage is implied.
- Missing owner sources, ambiguous identity, stale evidence, and skipped checks fail closed. Research, UI, Signal Bot, and Actions never create competing authoritative state.
- Never copy private host details, personal contact data, credentials, consumed grants, receipt payloads, or private operational paths into public-facing documentation.
